This is the most complex step. Must match frontend CSS filter rendering as closely as possible.
brightness: multiply RGB by factor. contrast: (pixel - 128) * factor + 128. saturate: convert to HSL, multiply S, convert back. All values are CSS-style (1.0 = no change).
hueRotate: rotate hue in HSL space by degrees. grayscale: luma = 0.2126*R + 0.7152*G + 0.0722*B, lerp toward gray. sepia: standard sepia matrix. All match CSS filter spec.
CSS blur is Gaussian. image::imageops::blur(img, sigma) should work. Map CSS blur px value to sigma.

CSS applies filters in declaration order. Frontend buildFilterString order: brightness, contrast, saturate, hue-rotate, grayscale, sepia, blur. Apply in same order. Skip filter if value equals default (1.0 for most, 0 for hueRotate/grayscale/sepia/blur).
Must match frontend useOverlayRenderer.ts rendering as closely as possible for visual consistency.
Frontend drawText: fontSize = size% of canvas, x = x% of canvas - textWidth/2, y = y% of canvas - fontSize/2. Shadow drawn first with offset and blur. Text drawn with textBaseline='top' equivalent.
Frontend drawLogo: maxDim = size% of canvas, contain-fit (scale to fit within maxDim×maxDim preserving aspect), center at (x%, y%). Logo at assets/brand/moafunk.png.
Frontend drawArtistName: binary search font size (min 10, max size% of canvas) until text width <= 35% of canvas width. Uses same draw + shadow logic as drawText.
